summary: Verified PDF import progress-bar fix. Ran isolated Playwright browser journey (1 passed, 54.49s) and full shared_v1 regression (118 passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped, 101.02s). Frontend smoke: admin/login renders with data-testid admin-login-phone-input, no compile errors in latest frontend log. Code review of PdfImport.js/ImportJob.js/pdfImport.js against the report's checklist (a)-(f) confirms all criteria met.
critical_code_review_comments: (a) PdfImport.js L64: progress panel is rendered when `running && current` and percent = doneBytes/totalBytes computed from per-file bytes (L55). No fake timer. ✓
(b) pdfImport.js L37-47: report(i) is invoked for every chunk including skipped (acknowledged) ones (L40) and after each successful chunk (L47); 'Finishing upload…' before /complete (L49). ✓
(c) ImportJob.js L41-44: ProgressBar clamps 0-100 via Math.max/Math.min, has role=progressbar and aria-valuenow, plus data-testid {id} and {id}-fill. ✓
(d) PdfImport.js L52-53: needBatch = !batch && files.length>0; amber alert also renders when no batches exist (list?.length===0). ✓
(e) PdfImport.js L20 writes localStorage only when id is truthy; L26 clears remembered batch if not in list and auto-selects when exactly one batch exists. ✓
(f) No secrets in files; all calls go through shared / api which use /api/bff/* and /api/admin/* via REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. ✓
test_credentials: None usable in preview (placeholder keys by design).
seed_data_creation: None (pytest uses isolated ASGI copy with SMS capture double).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Playwright browser is installed in the pod cache; if pod is restarted, run `python -m playwright install chromium` before the browser journey. Full suite is 118/118 green.
